I've recently been getting into using cleansing balms and double cleansing, and this balm is the absolute!! I've tried a cleansing balm from a different high end skincare brand and Oak Essential cleansing balm is honestly way better. First off, Oak Essential cleansing balm has way cleaner ingredients and is so silky on the skin. Secondly, it's actually cheaper, and yet higher quality and more environmentally kind. It also smells AMAZING and is definitely one you can take your time enjoying with all the senses. It's so gentle and really does remove all impurities and nasties. I use it with the Milk Cleanser and the two are chef's kiss! Highly highly recommend, you will not be disappointed.

It leaves my skin feeling and looking amazing, but there's no chance any serums or actives would penetrate this. This would be better as a slugging step at the end of your routine. I used a handful of times and trashed it since I has received it free product as a diamond member.

avis.texte: This balm is the ONLY makeup remover my skin can tolerate! Have tried so many cleasers and they burn and dry my skin. This does neither— it actually soothes it. Highlt recommended.

Love the cleansing balm and how well it removes my makeup and oil at night. Gentle yet effective

This product grew on me. I received a free bottle as one of my platinum perks and had never heard of this particular brand. I use oils and cleansing balms regularly and have late 30s combo skin. It reminds me of the Eve Lom brand cleanser. I didnt reallt care for it the first few times I used it , but it really grew on me. I would recommend this to people with drier skin and I used it in the winter. Like some of the other reviews state, its super thick and does not emulsify like most of the other balms on the market. However I would apply to my face and gently massage into my skin and then add a small amount of warm water and repeat. Next I used a very warm and wet washcloth and laid it on my face and would press that into my skin. I then gently used that cloth to wipe off the balm and would repeat this a couple of times. This left my skin feeling so soft and refreshed. It was also nice to just slow down and really let the heat and steam sit on my face. Overall this wont be for everyone, but after I get used to the consistency I enjoyed using it. I also loved how it was basically scent free and gentle. The only other con is the price is expensive for the amount you get. I would estimate one jar may last a month with nightly use.

You do have to follow the directions with this one. Just wet a washcloth with warm water, and your makeup will simply melt off your skin. My face feels so soft afterwards. Highly recommend for dry skin.
Love this cleansing balm!! Melts on your skin and wipes away my make-up with ease! My favorite jenni skin product so far!

this is one of the best cleansers to remove makeup and feel like it's all actually off. it leaves skin feeling super soft and clean. I get very sad when I run out between subscriptions as I am completely addicted to it.
This cleanser is wonderful, doesn't strip your skin, leaves very soft.
I love how this makes my skin feel so nourished after washing! Just what I need during the colder months.
This makes my dry, rough skin feel so soft. I like to use it with the renew face polish.

avis.titre: Mind blown by the positive reviews
avis.texte: Products like these make me so thankful that Ulta accepts returns. This cleansing balm was almost $50, and was essentially the equivalent of trying to cleanse my skin with aquaphor. I have used so many cleansing balms and this did not resemble anything close to any of them. It was so thick and greasy, and did not emulsify at all. It took a washcloth and two additional washes with a totally separate cleanser to remove it, and even then I felt like I had a layer of grease on my skin. I can not fathom the positive reviews on this item.

Almost got scared away from it by various people saying it was bad and doesn't rinse off their face. READ THE INSTRUCTIONS. It clearly says you need to wipe it off with a cloth. This is not one that will come off with just water. The product does have the weirdest texture when it comes in contact with water. It came off easily with a warm wash cloth. That being said, I do prefer ones I can just wash off with water. It worked, but nothing magical and not worth the price imo.

The only positive thing I can say is there is a pleasant scent. I have used many balms and oils and this was an absolute nightmare to remove from my skin. Despite using a substantial cotton pad and cleaning my face TWICE with another cleanser, I still had an oily film on my face. This balm is a very thick grease layer that does not wash off easily. I'm so glad I trialed in the winter instead of humid summer because it would likely have been on my face for 1 week. WILL NEVER repurchase of recommend. Will stick to Farmacy balm and Tatcha oil cleanser.

I'm reading all the positive good reviews, and had to double check that I did in fact have the same product. I hated this product because it felt like I was rubbing crisco/ thick grease all over my face. It wouldn't just come off with water either I had to scrape it off my face. The scent is very mild, but does have a light oak scent. I didn't like anything about this product, but maybe I just had a bad batch since there are so many great reviews.

This Cleansing Balm is pure magic! It melts away makeup and impurities while leaving my skin feeling soft and deeply moisturized. The balm-to-oil texture is so luxurious—my skin feels refreshed and hydrated every time!
